named_descent_lines.name: Named Descent Lines
named_descent_lines.observation: Every child is named into a line of mothers or fathers, and everyone knows whose kin they are and whom they may not marry.
named_descent_lines.social_consequence: Descent decides who helps whom; a child with a named line always has somewhere to go.

infant_carrying_slings.name: Carrying Slings and Cradleboards
infant_carrying_slings.observation: An infant bound in a sling or on a cradleboard rides on its mother's back while she gathers, warm, fed and watched.

shared_childcare.ability_reason: Children watched by kin while parents work are fed on time and kept from the fire and the water.

lineage_exogamy.name: Marrying Outside the Line
lineage_exogamy.observation: Young people must marry outside their own descent line, and the children of such matches are seen to be sturdier.
lineage_exogamy.social_consequence: Every marriage ties two lines together; feuds cool when both sides have grandchildren in common.

mouths_against_store.name: Mouths Counted Against the Store
mouths_against_store.observation: Before the winter the elders count the mouths against the baskets and pits, and rationing begins before hunger does.

patrilocal_residence.name: Bride Joins Her Husband's Kin
patrilocal_residence.observation: A married woman moves to her husband's household, and his kin gain a worker while she leaves her own mother behind.
patrilocal_residence.social_consequence: Brothers stay together and hold their land; young wives arrive as strangers and bear their first children far from their own mothers.

kin_care_widows_orphans.name: Kin Care for Widows and Orphans
kin_care_widows_orphans.observation: When a parent dies, kin take in the widow and the children, and orphans are fed at another hearth.
kin_care_widows_orphans.social_consequence: No child is left without a hearth; kin obligations are remembered and repaid.

maternal_recovery.ability_reason: A mother given food and lighter work after birth recovers, nurses and survives the next pregnancy.

household_space_planning.ability_reason: Homes laid out for sleep, air and care crowd less and sicken less.

village_marriage_alliances.name: Marriage Alliances Between Villages
village_marriage_alliances.observation: Daughters and sons are married into neighbouring villages, and the villages feast, trade and fight side by side.
village_marriage_alliances.social_consequence: Neighbours become in-laws; a raid on one village is an insult to the other's grandchildren.

elder_care_by_children.name: Elders Kept by Their Children
elder_care_by_children.observation: Grown children feed and house their aged parents, and the old keep their place at the hearth and in counsel.
elder_care_by_children.social_consequence: Children become the only sure provision for old age, and families want more of them.

winter_herder_return.name: Herders Winter in the Village
winter_herder_return.observation: Herders who follow the flocks all summer bring them home to the village for winter, and the families are together again.

bride_wealth_gifts.name: Bride Gifts
bride_wealth_gifts.observation: A groom's kin give livestock and goods to the bride's family, and the marriage is sealed in public.
bride_wealth_gifts.social_consequence: Young men depend on their elders for bride wealth; marriage waits on the herd.

captive_adoption.name: Adopting Captives and Strays
captive_adoption.observation: Captured children and lost wanderers are taken into a lineage, named and raised as kin.
captive_adoption.social_consequence: The adopted are kin in name but remember where they came from; some rise, some stay bound.

daughter_hamlets.name: Daughter Hamlets
daughter_hamlets.observation: When the village grows too crowded for its fields, a group of young families moves off to found a hamlet of its own.
daughter_hamlets.social_consequence: The parent village keeps its rites and its claim; the daughter hamlet owes it gifts and brides.

lean_year_dispersal.name: Lean-Year Dispersal
lean_year_dispersal.observation: In a bad year some families go to stay with kin in other valleys, and fewer mouths share the failing store.

harvest_headcount.name: Harvest Headcount
harvest_headcount.observation: At the harvest gathering every household is counted, so shares and stores match the people who need them.

new_household_plots.name: House Plots for New Households
new_household_plots.observation: A newly married couple is given a plot to build on, and young people marry sooner when a home is waiting.
new_household_plots.social_consequence: Land for a house becomes a right of marriage; who grants the plot gains a say over the match.

newcomer_host_season.name: Newcomers Hosted for a Season
newcomer_host_season.observation: A newcomer family works a season under a host household before it is given land, and learns the village's ways.

newcomer_intermarriage.name: Newcomers Marry In
newcomer_intermarriage.observation: Newcomers wed into local households, and within a generation their children are simply villagers.

satellite_hamlets.name: Satellite Hamlets
satellite_hamlets.observation: Small hamlets ring a central village, working outlying fields and gathering at the centre for rites and markets.
satellite_hamlets.social_consequence: The central village becomes a seat of elders and shrines; the hamlets owe it labour and gifts.

famine_refugee_hosting.name: Hosting Famine Refugees
famine_refugee_hosting.observation: Hungry families from failed lands are taken in by host villages, working for their keep until they can return or settle.
famine_refugee_hosting.social_consequence: Hosts gain workers and a debt of gratitude; the refugees bring fevers as well as hands.

hearth_counts.name: Households Counted by Hearth
hearth_counts.observation: Households are counted by their hearths, and each hearth owes its share of labor and grain.

carrying_capacity_awareness.name: Knowing When the Land Is Full
carrying_capacity_awareness.observation: The elders see that the fields and woods can feed no more mouths, and marriages and new hearths are held back until land is found.
carrying_capacity_awareness.social_consequence: Young people wait longer to marry; some leave to find land elsewhere.

kin_wards.name: Kin Wards
kin_wards.observation: A growing village divides into wards, each a cluster of related households sharing lanes, wells and a shrine.

protective_birth_amulets.name: Birth Amulets
protective_birth_amulets.observation: Mothers wear amulets through pregnancy and birth, and the calm they give the mother is its own help in labor.

rural_urban_migration.name: Towns Draw in Villagers
rural_urban_migration.observation: Work, markets and shrines draw villagers into the town, where they crowd close and fall sick more often than at home.
rural_urban_migration.social_consequence: The town grows by newcomers rather than by births; country kin and town kin drift apart.

people_herd_counts.name: Counts of People and Herds
people_herd_counts.observation: At set intervals the officials count the people and the herds of every village and write down the totals.

patron_protection.name: Outsiders Under a Patron
patron_protection.observation: A foreigner who takes a patron is protected by that house's name, and works and trades under it.
patron_protection.social_consequence: Patrons gain clients and labour; outsiders gain safety, at the price of dependence.

midwife_apprenticeship_lines.social_consequence: Midwifery becomes a line passed from mother to daughter or mistress to apprentice, with its own standing.

recorded_dowry.name: Recorded Dowry
recorded_dowry.observation: Betrothal gifts and the bride's dowry are listed before witnesses, so the wife's portion can be claimed back.

household_vital_lists.name: Births and Deaths Listed
household_vital_lists.observation: Household lists record who is born and who dies, and the scribes see which seasons and quarters lose the most children.

birth_stool_bricks.name: Birth Stool and Birth Bricks
birth_stool_bricks.observation: A mother squats on two birth bricks or a stool with an open seat, and the midwife can reach the child as it comes.

ward_residence_lists.name: Ward Residence Lists
ward_residence_lists.observation: The residents of each ward are listed by house, so labour, grain and levies fall on the people actually there.

partible_inheritance.name: Shared Inheritance
partible_inheritance.observation: An estate is divided among the children in set shares, and every heir gets land, though each generation's plots are smaller.
partible_inheritance.social_consequence: Every child has a stake; fields shrink with each division and brothers quarrel over boundaries.

named_year_ages.name: Ages by Named Years
named_year_ages.observation: Each year is named for a great event, and a person's age is told by the year of their birth.

fraternal_joint_estates.name: Brothers' Joint Estates
fraternal_joint_estates.observation: Brothers hold their father's land together rather than dividing it, and work it as one household.
fraternal_joint_estates.social_consequence: The estate stays whole; younger brothers marry later or not at all.

belonging_oaths.name: Oaths of Belonging
belonging_oaths.observation: A settled outsider swears before the gods and the elders to keep the town's laws, and is counted among its people.

wet_nurse_contracts.name: Wet-Nurse Contracts
wet_nurse_contracts.observation: A wet nurse is hired by contract for a fixed payment of grain, oil and cloth to nurse a child for two or three years.
wet_nurse_contracts.social_consequence: Infants whose mothers die or cannot nurse now live; nursing becomes paid work.

divorce_settlements.name: Divorce Settlements
divorce_settlements.observation: When a marriage ends the law returns the wife's dowry and sets who keeps the children.

widow_portion_law.name: Widow's Portion by Law
widow_portion_law.observation: The law secures a widow a portion of her husband's estate to live on and raise her children.

contraceptive_pessaries.name: Pessaries to Delay Pregnancy
contraceptive_pessaries.observation: Lint soaked in honey and acacia gum placed before intercourse delays the next pregnancy, giving the mother time to recover.
contraceptive_pessaries.social_consequence: Women gain some say over when to bear children; fewer births, but more of them survive.

three_year_nursing.name: Three-Year Nursing
three_year_nursing.observation: Mothers nurse each child for three years by custom, and the next child comes later and stronger.
three_year_nursing.social_consequence: Families grow more slowly, but fewer small graves are dug.

levirate_marriage.name: Levirate Marriage
levirate_marriage.observation: A widow is married to her dead husband's brother, keeping her and her children within the family and on its land.

frontier_settler_grants.name: Frontier Land Grants
frontier_settler_grants.observation: Soldiers and settlers are granted land on the frontier in return for service, and new villages rise along the border.
frontier_settler_grants.social_consequence: Landless younger sons find a future on the frontier; the frontier fills with families loyal to the grantor.
